_comment: Bytes-level attestation over a tree of preserved evidence. Written by tools/corpuscheck/attest.py and read by the `preserved-evidence` check. This file is NOT a record of a run and carries no measurement; it is a witness held outside the tree it attests. Rebuilding it does not restore a green gate on its own — `preserved_evidence.units[].attestation_sha256` in tools/corpuscheck/config.json pins these bytes and is edited by hand.
reason: Extending the OD-31 bytes-level attestation to the blind adjudication study, preserved evidence on the same ruling and left uncovered when the guard was priced over the run directories alone.
